story: Implement core hook type enum and supporting structures
story_description: As a Blaze developer, I need strongly-typed hook types with validation so that the hooks builder can enforce correct hook configuration and provide helpful guidance to users.
task: Create HookTypes.swift with HookType enum, HookDefinition struct, TemplateVariable, and HookValidationError
task_description: Implement the foundational type system for hooks including the HookType enum with three cases (prompt, command, agent), each with display metadata, default timeouts, and available template variables. Include HookDefinition struct for hook instances with type-specific validation, TemplateVariable for documenting available variables, and HookValidationError for validation feedback.
atom: HookType enum with cases, computed properties, and template variables
atom_description: Define HookType as a String-backed Codable enum with prompt, command, and agent cases. Implement computed properties for displayName, icon (SF Symbol), description, defaultTimeout, and templateVariables. The templateVariables property returns type-specific TemplateVariable arrays documenting available substitution variables for prompt hooks ($TOOL_INPUT, $TOOL_RESULT, $USER_PROMPT, $TRANSCRIPT_PATH) and command hooks ($CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, $CLAUDE_ENV_FILE, $CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE).
problem_statement: The hooks builder UI needs a type-safe foundation to represent the three hook types supported by Claude Code (prompt, command, agent). Each type has different execution semantics, timeouts, and available template variables. Without this type system, the UI cannot provide accurate guidance, validation, or autocomplete for hook configuration.
scope_in: HookType enum with prompt, command, agent cases
CaseIterable and Sendable conformance for SwiftUI iteration
Computed icon returning SF Symbol names for UI
Computed description returning help text explaining each type
Computed defaultTimeout returning seconds (30 for prompt, 60 for command, 120 for agent)
Computed templateVariables returning type-specific TemplateVariable arrays
TemplateVariable struct with name and description properties
HookDefinition struct with id, type, timeout, prompt, command, agent, once properties
HookValidationError enum with missingPrompt, missingCommand, missingAgent, relativePathWarning, invalidTimeout cases
HookValidationError.isWarning computed property to distinguish warnings from errors
scope_out: Hook event types (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, etc.) - covered in separate atom
Hook matcher patterns - covered in separate atom
Hook persistence to settings.json - covered in separate atom
Hook execution runtime - covered in separate atom
Hook testing infrastructure - covered in separate atom
assumptions: Claude Code hook schema version 2.1.0+ is the target compatibility level
Agent type hooks are available in Claude Code 2.1.0 and later
Template variable syntax uses dollar-sign prefix ($VARIABLE)
SF Symbol names are valid for the current macOS deployment target
Timeout values in seconds are consistent with Claude Code CLI behavior
constraints: Must use String raw value for HookType to match JSON serialization
Must conform to Sendable for safe use across actor boundaries
Must conform to Codable for JSON persistence
Timeout range must be 1-600 seconds per Claude Code limits
Must use UUID for HookDefinition.id to ensure uniqueness
functional_requirements: FR1: HookType.prompt case with displayName Prompt, icon brain, timeout 30s
FR2: HookType.command case with displayName Command, icon terminal, timeout 60s
FR3: HookType.agent case with displayName Agent, icon person.crop.circle, timeout 120s
FR7: HookDefinition.validate() returns missingPrompt when prompt type lacks prompt string
FR8: HookDefinition.validate() returns missingCommand when command type lacks command string
FR9: HookDefinition.validate() returns missingAgent when agent type lacks agent string
FR10: HookDefinition.validate() returns relativePathWarning when command lacks $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and does not start with /
FR11: HookDefinition.validate() returns invalidTimeout when timeout outside 1-600 range
FR12: HookValidationError.relativePathWarning.isWarning returns true, all others return false
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: All types must be Sendable for thread-safe UI updates
NFR2: Enum iteration via CaseIterable for picker population
NFR3: Hashable conformance on HookDefinition for SwiftUI list identification
NFR4: LocalizedError conformance for user-friendly error messages
NFR5: Zero external dependencies - Foundation only
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create file Blaze/Sources/Core/Hooks/HookTypes.swift with Foundation import
Step 2: Define HookType enum with String raw value, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable conformance
Step 3: Add prompt, command, agent cases to HookType
Step 4: Implement displayName computed property with switch returning Prompt, Command, Agent
Step 5: Implement icon computed property with switch returning brain, terminal, person.crop.circle
Step 6: Implement description computed property with switch returning help text for each type
Step 7: Implement defaultTimeout computed property with switch returning 30, 60, 120
Step 8: Define TemplateVariable struct with Identifiable (id = name), Sendable, name and description properties
Step 9: Implement templateVariables computed property returning type-specific TemplateVariable arrays
Step 10: Define HookDefinition struct with Codable, Sendable, Identifiable, Hashable conformance
Step 11: Add HookDefinition properties: id (UUID), type (HookType), timeout (Int?), prompt (String?), command (String?), agent (String?), once (Bool?)
Step 12: Implement HookDefinition.init(type:) setting type and default timeout
Step 13: Implement HookDefinition.validate() method with type-specific validation logic
Step 14: Define HookValidationError enum with Sendable conformance and five cases
Step 15: Implement LocalizedError conformance with errorDescription computed property
Step 16: Implement isWarning computed property returning true only for relativePathWarning

ui_copy: HookType.prompt.description: Use LLM reasoning for context-aware decisions. Best for complex validation that requires understanding code semantics.
HookType.command.description: Execute bash scripts for deterministic validation. Best for fast checks, file operations, and external tool integration.
HookType.agent.description: Tie into agent/subagent lifecycle events. Available in v2.1.0+ for advanced orchestration.
HookValidationError.missingPrompt.errorDescription: Prompt hook requires a prompt string
HookValidationError.missingCommand.errorDescription: Command hook requires a command string
HookValidationError.missingAgent.errorDescription: Agent hook requires an agent name
edge_cases: EC1: Empty string prompt (whitespace only) must trigger missingPrompt error
EC2: Empty string command (whitespace only) must trigger missingCommand error
EC3: Empty string agent (whitespace only) must trigger missingAgent error
EC4: Command starting with / should not trigger relativePathWarning
EC5: Command containing $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT anywhere should not trigger relativePathWarning
EC6: Timeout of exactly 1 should be valid (boundary)
EC7: Timeout of exactly 600 should be valid (boundary)
EC8: Timeout of 0 should trigger invalidTimeout
EC9: Timeout of 601 should trigger invalidTimeout
EC10: nil timeout should be valid (uses default)
EC11: HookDefinition with multiple validation errors returns all errors in array
failure_modes: FM1: Invalid JSON decode of HookType falls back to DecodingError.dataCorrupted
FM2: Invalid UUID string in HookDefinition.id causes decode failure
FM3: Unknown HookType raw value in JSON causes decode failure - no fallback case
FM4: Memory pressure during large TemplateVariable array creation - unlikely given fixed small arrays
